Ten polypropylene baby bottles, representing about 70 percent of the global market, released 1.3 to 16.2 million microplastic particles per litre of prepared formula.

Trinity College Dublin, published in Nature Food, 2020.

Heat is what drives it.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-non-toxic-baby-bottles.html

Bedrooms with synthetic carpet measure 8,000 to 17,000 microplastic fibres per cubic metre of air.

Hard flooring runs 2,000 to 6,000.

You spend a third of your life breathing that, which makes the bedroom the highest exposure room in the house.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/microplastics-in-bedroom-air.html

UC Berkeley researchers tested 30 tampons across 14 brands in 2024.

Every one of the 16 metals screened for was detected in every single product. Mean lead concentration was 120 nanograms per gram.

Organic cotton did not exempt them.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-non-toxic-period-products.html

The white ring inside a metal jar lid is a PVC plastisol gasket.

It is 25 to 45 percent plasticiser by weight, and it sits in direct contact with whatever is in the jar.

Glass jar, plastic seal. Almost nobody checks the lid.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/plastic-in-jar-lids.html

That new shower curtain smell is 108 different volatile organic compounds.

A single PVC curtain released all of them in testing by the Center for Health, Environment and Justice.

It is not a smell. It is an emissions profile.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-non-toxic-shower-curtains.html

Sea salt tested at 550 to 681 microplastic particles per kilogram.

Rock and well salts, mined from deposits laid down long before plastic existed, came in at 7 to 204.

The premium option is the contaminated one here.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/microplastics-in-salt-and-pantry-staples.html

Consumer Reports tested 118 food packaging products in 2022. More than half had measurable organic fluorine, the marker for total PFAS.

Grease proofing agents left the US market in 2024, but old stock, imports and recycled fibre still test positive.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/pfas-in-fast-food-packaging.html

Most yoga mats are PVC, which means phthalates, pressed against your face for an hour while you breathe hard.

Natural tree rubber has no PVC, no phthalates and no heavy metals. Cork over rubber grips better as you sweat.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-non-toxic-yoga-mats.html

A baby wears roughly 6,000 diapers before potty training, against skin, all day. Few products get that much contact.

Coterie tested non detect for PFAS markers in independent 2023 testing and publishes a full layer by layer material list.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-non-toxic-diapers.html

A HEPA filter only does what it claims if the unit is sealed around it.

Many purifiers let air slip past the filter edge instead of through it, which matters most for the fine fraction you actually want captured.

Look for sealed HEPA, not HEPA type.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-air-purifiers-for-microplastics.html
